prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Atlanta to replace my air conditioner?
ai_overview_text:
Top-rated HVAC companies in Atlanta for air conditioner replacement include Reliable Heating & Air, TE Certified, Moncrief Heating & Air Conditioning, and PV Heating, Cooling & Plumbing, all of which maintain high customer satisfaction and strong regional standing. Reliable Heating & Air +2
Founded: 1978
Highlights: Operating over 200 service trucks, they offer specialized packages like the Bulldogs Comfort Program (Trane 14 SEER systems with cash incentives) and monthly financing options.
Website: Reliable Heating & Air
Get at least 3 quotes: Prices and equipment tiers (such as SEER2 efficiency ratings) vary widely between local boutique shops and large multi-service companies.
Check warranties: Look for strong manufacturer warranties (typically 10 years on parts) combined with a solid labor/workmanship warranty from the installer.
Verify sizing: Ensure the company performs a proper Manual J load calculation rather than just guessing the size based on your old unit's square footage.
To help narrow this down, what is the approximate square footage of your home, and are you looking for a standard AC system or a high-efficiency heat pump?
